name: Being a good son
source:
Being a good son is a mainly based on a visual novel where you will take the role of a boy who has just moved,
with his family to a new city with many secrets​.

[From F95zone]
translation:
《Being a good son》是一款以视觉小说形式为主的游戏。你将扮演一个刚随家人搬到新城市的男孩，而这座城市隐藏着许多秘密。

[摘自F95zone]
